title: 第7章 风龙敖青第8章 逃出溶洞
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 提前产生的吸力让郑常始料未及，让他直接滑倒。
水流开始推着他向前进。
好在手里还有一把拐棍，郑常立刻用它撑住水底，减缓了速度，同时抽出了别在腰间的短剑，插到了水底。
有了两个支点，郑常止住了下降。
可惜手里用来照明的灵石手电脱手掉了出去。
郑常眼睁睁的看着它随着水流飘走，落入洞穴中央，中央好像有什么东西，嗖的一下把它吸走了。
随着光源的消失，整个洞穴陷入了一片漆黑。
郑常心都要跳出来了，死死抓着拐棍和匕首，生怕落的和灵石手电一个下场。
可能是心理作用，郑常感觉这一次的吸力好像持续了特别久。
等到吸力停止，脚下的水已经被吸了个干净。
此时郑常的眼睛也适应了黑暗，这才发现，洞穴里也不是彻底没有光源的。
刚刚把灵石手电吸走的地方，此刻正隐隐泛着幽光。
郑常犹豫了一下，小心翼翼的走了过去。
吸力来自这里，那应有什么洞穴或者通道在下面吧。
然而当郑常靠近之后，才看看清楚，正在发出的幽光的，是什么东西。
那是个下巴以下截肢的龙。
只留下一个遍布鳞片。长有鬃毛、犄角的头。
这还是郑常在穿越后，第一次看到地球中不存在的生物。
他兴奋之余又隐隐有些担心，毕竟是野生的，不会咬人吧。
可转念一想，又觉得自己的害怕有些多余。
就剩下一个脑袋了，估计死的不能再死了。
一道声音却在这时，从龙头处传来。
“终于等到你了，有风灵根的人！”
郑常吓了一跳，连忙后退。
乖乖，就剩一个脑袋还能活，修仙界的生物这么要命的吗？
怕不是想要吃了自己让身体长出来，还是赶紧溜了。
见郑常想要逃跑。那声音连忙道。
“年轻人！先别走！我没有恶意的。请你先听我说。”
郑常愣了一下，看着眼前的黑漆漆的道路，从系统空间中拿出另一个灵石手电筒，打着了就准备出发了。
“等一下，我求求你了，别走好吗，我什么都会做的！我发誓！保证不会伤害你！若我有歹意，让我承受天罚”
那道声音已经哀求起来，语气中甚至带着些哭腔了。
郑常听完，在脑海里问系统：“系统，在修仙界发誓违反了，真的会遭报应吗？”
【会的，不过宿主可以消耗运气抵挡报应，以宿主的S级运气天赋，应该能挡一次天罚。】
原来如此，郑常转头看向那颗龙头，都剩下一颗头，应该不太可能有S级以上的运气吧。
“你说吧，我在听。”郑常开口道。
对方立刻转悲为喜，连忙道：“谢谢！太谢谢你了，你真是个好人。”
content_en:
The suction generated in advance caught Zheng Chang by surprise and caused him to slip directly.
The current began to push him forward.
Fortunately, he still had a walking stick in his hand. Zheng Chang immediately used it to support the bottom of the water, slowing down his speed. At the same time, he took out the short sword from his waist and inserted it into the bottom of the water.
With two fulcrums, Zheng Chang stopped his decline.
Unfortunately, the spirit stone flashlight he was using for lighting fell out of his hand.
Zheng Chang watched helplessly as it floated away with the current and fell into the center of the cave. There seemed to be something in the center, sucking it away with a swish.
As the light source disappeared, the entire cave fell into darkness.
Zheng Chang's heart almost jumped out of his chest. He held on to the walking stick and dagger tightly, fearing that they would end up like the Lingshi flashlight.
Perhaps it was a psychological effect, but Zheng Chang felt that the suction lasted for a particularly long time this time.
By the time the suction stopped, all the water under my feet had been sucked clean.
At this time, Zheng Chang's eyes also adapted to the darkness, and he realized that there was not completely no light source in the cave.
The place where the spirit stone flashlight had just been sucked away was now faintly glowing with light.
Zheng Chang hesitated for a moment and walked over cautiously.
The suction comes from here, so there should be some cave or passage underneath.
However, when Zheng Chang got closer, he could see clearly what was emitting the faint light.
It was a dragon that had been amputated below the chin.
Only one was left covered in scales. Head with mane and horns.
This was the first time Zheng Chang saw a creature that did not exist on the earth after traveling through time.
He was excited but also slightly worried. After all, it was wild and couldn't bite.
But when I thought about it again, I felt that my fear was a bit unnecessary.
There's only one head left, and it's probably too late to die.
But at this moment, a voice came from the dragon head.
"I've finally waited for you, the one with wind spirit roots!"
Zheng Chang was startled and quickly backed away.
Darling, you can still live with only one head left. Are the creatures in the world of immortality so deadly?
I was afraid that I didn't want to eat myself to make my body grow, so I ran away quickly.
Seeing Zheng Chang want to run away. The voice said quickly.
"Young man! Don't leave yet! I don't mean any harm. Please listen to me first."
Zheng Chang was stunned for a moment, looked at the dark road in front of him, took out another spirit stone flashlight from the system space, lit it and was ready to set off.
"Wait a minute, I beg you, please don't leave, okay? I will do anything! I swear! I promise I will not hurt you! If I have any malicious intentions, let me bear the punishment from heaven."
The voice had begun to plead, and there was even a hint of crying in its tone.
After Zheng Chang listened, he asked the system in his mind: "System, if you violate the oath in the world of cultivating immortals, will you really suffer retribution?"
[Yes, but the host can use luck to resist retribution. With the host's S-level luck talent, it should be able to block a natural punishment. 】
It turns out that was the case. Zheng Chang turned to look at the dragon head. There was only one head left. It was unlikely that he had luck above S level.
"You tell me, I'm listening." Zheng Chang said.
The other party immediately turned from sadness to joy and said quickly: "Thank you! Thank you so much, you are such a good person."
title_en: Chapter 7 Wind Dragon Ao Qing Chapter 8 Escape from the Cave
